title: Your battery works harder in cold weather
caption: Saskatoon winters can make an aging battery harder on your vehicle. Before the first freeze, have the battery and starting system checked—especially if your car is slow to start or lights seem dim. A quick check now can help prevent an inconvenient roadside visit.
image_prompt: Professional mobile mechanic testing a vehicle battery with a multimeter on a cold, snowy morning in Saskatoon, natural winter light, realistic documentary photography, no logos or text

title: When the car says ‘one tiny problem’
caption: One warning light appears, and suddenly every sound becomes suspicious. If your vehicle is making an unfamiliar noise or showing a warning, don’t guess—have it checked before the small issue becomes a big roadside headache.
image_prompt: Humorous winter roadside scene in Saskatoon with a car displaying an illuminated dashboard warning light, light snowfall, driver looking mildly concerned, realistic photography, no brand logos or readable text

title: A mechanic comes to the awkward situation
caption: Picture this: it’s cold, the line at the garage stretches across the parking lot, and your vehicle needs attention. A mobile mechanic can handle many common repairs wherever you are, so you can stay comfortable while the work gets done.
image_prompt: Mobile mechanic working inside a tidy service van in a snowy Saskatoon neighbourhood, warm workshop lighting contrasting with the winter outdoors, candid realistic photography, no logos or text

title: Winter tires matter for more than the snow
caption: Cold temperatures affect tire performance, and worn or damaged tires can compromise handling on icy and snow-covered roads. Check tire condition and pressure according to your vehicle’s guidance, and replace damaged tires promptly. When in doubt, have a qualified technician inspect them.
image_prompt: Close-up of a technician carefully inspecting winter tire tread and sidewall damage on a cold day in Saskatoon, snowy road softly blurred in the background, realistic professional photography, no logos or text

title: Skip the shop wait when the issue is minor
caption: If your vehicle needs a straightforward repair, having a mobile mechanic come to you may help avoid the wait at a busy repair shop. Book service for a convenient time at home or work, with no need for an unnecessary tow when the vehicle is safe to drive.
image_prompt: Mobile mechanic arriving in a branded-but-unbranded service van at a Saskatoon driveway, customer greeting the technician beside their vehicle, snowy residential street, natural candid photography, no visible logos or text
